item.title: Cyberpunk 2077 2.5 Update Adds Mods & Edgerunners Gear
item.description: CD Projekt Red’s 2.5 patch for Cyberpunk 2077 adds console cross‑platform mod support, new Edgerunners‑inspired quests, gear, and a dual‑wield perk.
